name: figmavars
description: FigmaVars — turn a Figma variables export into a production design token pipeline. Monorepo for @figmavars/* packages.
author: Mark Learst

scripts.check:publint: publint packages/core && publint packages/dtcg && publint packages/cli && publint packages/hooks && publint packages/mcp
scripts.check:attw: attw --pack packages/core --profile node16 && attw --pack packages/dtcg && attw --pack packages/hooks && attw --pack packages/mcp --profile esm-only
scripts.check:release: pnpm run build && pnpm run check:release-metadata && pnpm run check:publint && pnpm run check:attw && pnpm --filter @figmavars/hooks run check:size
